LOGIN_WITHOUT_MFA.title: Secure Authentication
LOGIN_WITHOUT_MFA.requirement: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be established and implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.
LOGIN_WITHOUT_MFA.failure: Console login was permitted without multi-factor authentication.

PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION.title: Access Control
PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION.requirement: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on business and information security requirements.
PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION.failure: A new account was created and granted administrator privileges without authorization controls.

PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION.title: Access Rights
PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION.requirement: Access rights to information and other associated assets shall be provisioned, reviewed, modified and removed in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on and rules for access control.
PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION.failure: Administrator access rights were provisioned outside the established access management process.

PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION.title: Privileged Access Rights
PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION.requirement: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.
PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION.failure: AdministratorAccess policy was attached without privileged access management controls.

AUDIT_TRAIL_TAMPERING.title: Logging
AUDIT_TRAIL_TAMPERING.requirement: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analysed.
AUDIT_TRAIL_TAMPERING.failure: CloudTrail logging was stopped and the trail was deleted, destroying audit records.

AUDIT_TRAIL_TAMPERING.title: Clock Synchronization
AUDIT_TRAIL_TAMPERING.requirement: The clocks of information processing systems used by the organization shall be synchronized to approved time sources.
AUDIT_TRAIL_TAMPERING.failure: Deletion of logging infrastructure undermines the integrity of time-synchronized audit records.

SENSITIVE_DATA_ACCESS.title: Classification of Information
SENSITIVE_DATA_ACCESS.requirement: Information shall be classified according to the information security needs of the organization based on confidentiality, integrity, availability and relevant interested party requirements.
SENSITIVE_DATA_ACCESS.failure: PII and financial data was accessed without classification-based access restrictions.

SENSITIVE_DATA_ACCESS.title: Information Access Restriction
SENSITIVE_DATA_ACCESS.requirement: Access to information and other associated assets shall be restricted in accordance with the established topic-specific policy on access control.
SENSITIVE_DATA_ACCESS.failure: Sensitive data buckets (customer PII, financial reports, payroll) were accessed by an unauthorized account.

SENSITIVE_DATA_ACCESS.title: Privacy and Protection of PII
SENSITIVE_DATA_ACCESS.requirement: The organization shall identify and meet the requirements regarding the preservation of privacy and protection of PII according to applicable laws, regulations and contractual requirements.
SENSITIVE_DATA_ACCESS.failure: Customer PII was accessed and potentially exfiltrated without authorization.

UNUSUAL_HOURS.title: Monitoring Activities
UNUSUAL_HOURS.requirement: Networks, systems and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.
UNUSUAL_HOURS.failure: Activity during unusual hours was not detected or prevented by monitoring controls.

SELF_DELETION.title: Logging
SELF_DELETION.requirement: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analysed.
SELF_DELETION.failure: An account was able to delete itself, potentially erasing evidence of unauthorized activity.

SELF_DELETION.title: Compliance with Policies, Rules and Standards
SELF_DELETION.requirement: Compliance with the organization's established information security policy, topic-specific policies, rules and standards shall be regularly reviewed.
SELF_DELETION.failure: Self-deletion of accounts indicates lack of enforcement of identity lifecycle controls.
